derivation.job_note: ADDED with replicate-conditional calibration. It is a fourth level and changes none of the three above: master_seed and every family seed below are bit-identical to schema/1. Required because one replicate needs one calibration artifact per field, and a single per-replicate stream consumed sequentially would make artifact contents depend on field processing ORDER, so a parallel execution could not reproduce a serial one.
